production.note: US model year 2018 only. Dodge: 'Introduction Date | Fourth quarter 2017 as a 2018 model'. The Drive (Chris Constantine): the last car rolled off the line at Brampton on 30 May 2018; 3,300 were built and the car was limited to 'one model year' (thedrive-demon-final).

body.note: 'Body Style | Two-door coupe'. Seating '1/0 – standard', with front-passenger and rear seats optional.

transmission.note: 'TRANSMISSION: TORQUEFLITE 8HP90 EIGHT-SPEED AUTOMATIC | Availability | Standard'. No manual was offered.

powerHp.note: On pump fuel. Quote: "808 bhp (603 kW) @ 6,300 rpm with Premium 91 octane fuel". With the Direct Connection controller and 100-octane fuel Dodge rates it at "840 bhp (626 kW) @ 6,300 rpm"; the 91-octane figure is used because that is how the car is delivered and fuelled.

weightLb.note: Quote (Dodge specification sheet, 'DIMENSIONS AND CAPACITIES'): "Curb Weight | 4,280". The car as delivered has only a driver's seat; the passenger and rear seats are options.

sources.title: The Final 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon Has Been Built

discrepancies.reason: Fuel and engine controller: 808 hp on 91-octane pump fuel, 840 hp with the Direct Connection controller and 100-octane fuel.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 808 hp, the rating on the fuel the car is sold to run on.
